title.narrative: Empower women in inclusive cultural and creative industries in Baalbeck Festival

description.narrative:
Baalbeck, as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is not only a testament to Lebanon's rich historical tapestry, but also a symbol of resilience and cultural pride for the Lebanese people. Its ruins and festivals continue to inspire and attract visitors from around the globe. The Baalbeck International Festival, held within the ancient ruins, showcases performances by renowned artists from around the world. It highlights the city's ongoing cultural relevance and its role as a beacon of artistic expression in Lebanon.
The project aims to recognize and amplify the women’s creative contributions to the Baalbeck International Festival, seeking to inspire future generations and promote gender equality in cultural representation and fostering a more inclusive artistic landscape.
More specifically, the objectives are as follows: 1. Increasing the visibility of women’s contributions at the Baalbeck International Festival and beyond. 2. Promoting gender equality and empowerment through capacity building opportunities for women. 3. Fostering a more inclusive and diverse cultural landscape that values and supports the creative talents of women while promoting broader gender equality in cultural programming and management.
